name: Generative AI
description: Generative AI end to end: LLMs, prompting, fine-tuning, RAG, agents, diffusion, VLMs and running GenAI in production.

items.title: Hugging Face NLP Course
items.description: Transformers, fine-tuning and LLM fundamentals with hands-on code.

items.title: DeepLearning.AI Short Courses
items.description: Practical AI courses from industry experts.

items.title: Attention Is All You Need
items.description: The Transformer paper that made generative AI possible.

items.title: OpenAI Documentation
items.description: API reference for GPT models, embeddings and function calling.

items.title: LangChain Documentation
items.description: Frameworks for RAG, agents and LLM applications.

items.title: Diffusers Documentation
items.description: State-of-the-art diffusion models for image generation.

lessons.title: What Is Generative AI?
lessons.description: The field that creates text, images, audio and code — and the system stack behind it.

lessons.title: The Mathematics of Generation
lessons.description: Generation is sampling from a probability distribution over tokens — conditioned on context.

lessons.title: Text Generation Fundamentals
lessons.description: Generate text with pretrained models: sampling strategies, decoding, and the tokens that come out.

lessons.title: Prompt Engineering
lessons.description: Design instructions that get reliable outputs: roles, structure, few-shot examples and constraints.

lessons.title: In-Context Learning
lessons.description: Teach new tasks with examples in the prompt — no weight updates required.

lessons.title: LLM Architecture & Scaling
lessons.description: Decoder-only transformers, scaling laws, and why bigger models behave differently.

lessons.title: Tokenization & the Vocabulary
lessons.description: Subword tokens (BPE) — the hidden layer between characters and embeddings.

lessons.title: Fine-Tuning LLMs
lessons.description: Adapt a foundation model to a domain with supervised fine-tuning and parameter-efficient methods (LoRA).

lessons.title: RLHF & Alignment
lessons.description: Train models to be helpful and harmless: reward models, RLHF and constitutional methods.

lessons.title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
lessons.description: Ground answers in your own data: retrieve relevant chunks, stuff the context, generate.

lessons.title: Embeddings & Vector Databases
lessons.description: Semantic search at scale: embedding models, vector indexes, and ANN search.

lessons.title: Agents & Tool Use
lessons.description: Let models call functions, use tools, and loop until the job is done.

lessons.title: Diffusion Models for Images
lessons.description: Generate images by learning to denoise: forward noise, reverse denoising, and text conditioning.

lessons.title: Generative Adversarial Networks
lessons.description: Two networks in a zero-sum game: the generator fools the discriminator, and both improve.

lessons.title: Vision-Language Models
lessons.description: Bridge images and text: CLIP, captioning, and multimodal chat (LLaVA, GPT-4V).

lessons.title: Generative Audio & Speech
lessons.description: Text-to-speech, voice cloning and music generation with modern neural audio models.

lessons.title: Evaluating LLMs
lessons.description: Benchmarks, evals and human review — measuring quality, safety and reliability.

lessons.title: LLMOps: Running GenAI in Production
lessons.description: Prompt management, caching, guardrails, monitoring and cost control for LLM apps.

lessons.title: Ethical AI & Safety
lessons.description: Bias, privacy, transparency and misuse — the responsibilities that come with generative models.

lessons.title: Building a GenAI Application
lessons.description: Assemble the stack: model, retrieval, guardrails and a clean interface — end to end.

lessons.title: Generative AI Roadmap
lessons.description: Synthesize everything into a career and project plan — and keep up as the field accelerates.
